note: Forward-looking only: today's PCR or max-pain distance against what the index did over the next 1, 5 and 20 sessions. Same-day 'accuracy' would be circular, because both are computed from the same open interest.

cautions.small: Results under 20 cases are not published.
cautions.baseline: Every figure is shown next to the index's own average move over the same horizon, so you can see whether the signal adds anything.
cautions.survivorship: Index level only - no stock selection bias.
cautions.not_a_signal: A historical tendency is not a prediction. If the edge is small relative to the spread, it is not tradable after costs.
